page.overview:
Who is Baby Triceratops?

The baby Triceratops is kept in a Jurassic Park branded stroller when it is on display.

The baby Triceratops can sometimes be spotted as a meet and greet encounter at the park, where she can be joined by the baby Velociraptor and Ankylosaurus, alongside an adult Triceratops, Stegosaurus and a pack of Velociraptors.
